claude_proposed_widenings.name: imprison_in_area
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Creatures that failed the save and are completely within the sphere are trapped inside — they cannot exit through the sphere wall. The existing block_travel atom is a property of an area boundary (Wall of Force / Forcecage semantics), not a per-creature constraint applied to individuals on a failed save. There is no directional variant ('can't exit') vs ('can't enter'), and no per-creature application path that would distinguish the trapped creatures from the ones that are merely outside. A new atom is needed for 'bearer/subject cannot leave the enclosing area.'
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Any creature that failed the save and is completely within the area is trapped inside this sphere.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger.on_enclosed_creature_spends_action
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: An enclosed creature spending a Utilize action causes the sphere to move up to half that creature's Speed. The existing trigger vocabulary has on_caster_spends_action (the caster, not a trapped creature) and no trigger for 'a creature enclosed by the area attachment spends a specific action type.' This is a novel subject-relative trigger needed to model the moveable sphere mechanic.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: An enclosed creature can take a Utilize action to push against the sphere's wall, moving the sphere up to half the creature's Speed.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivatedAbilityMechanics.range
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The bead is thrown up to 60 feet and the explosion/sphere originate at the point of impact (area origin: point_within_range). ActivatedAbilityMechanics has no range field; the tracer hardcodes range: { kind: 'self' } for all activated abilities, causing any area attachment to print 'origin: point within Self' instead of 'within 60 ft'. MagicItemSpawnedCreatureMechanics and TriggeredReactionAbilityMechanics already carry range: Range — ActivatedAbilityMechanics should gain the same field.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take a Magic action to throw the bead up to 60 feet.
